title: Understand your risk preferences
purpose: Reflect stated preferences and access needs; do not derive a volatility target or investment allocation.

questions.prompt: When might you need some of this money?
Could you cover an unexpected expense without selling these investments?

choices.label: Yes, using money outside this portfolio
Partly; I might need some of this money
I would probably need this portfolio

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes what you want?

choices.label: Keeping the balance relatively steady matters most
I want a balance between stability and growth
I want growth and accept that the balance can swing

questions.prompt: If the value fell 20% over a few months, what would you most likely do?

choices.label: Sell some or most of the investments
Keep the holdings while reviewing the situation
I don't know how I would react

questions.prompt: What decline would start feeling hard to tolerate?
questions.help: Use a hypothetical $1,000 balance to picture the change. A loss can last or become larger; recovery is not assumed.

choices.label: I can't put a number on it yet
